items.exampleEn: We spent the afternoon roaming the old town.
items.exampleZh: 我們花了一下午在老城區閒逛。

items.exampleEn: The abandoned factory is now an art center.
items.exampleZh: 那座廢棄的工廠現在是一個藝術中心。

items.exampleEn: The cat overturned a cup of milk on the table.
items.exampleZh: 貓把桌上的一杯牛奶打翻了。

items.exampleEn: With one strong tug, she opened the old window.
items.exampleZh: 她用力一拉，打開了那扇舊窗戶。

items.exampleEn: The discharge of smoke from the chimney turned the sky gray.
items.exampleZh: 煙囪排出的煙把天空染成灰色。

items.exampleEn: The exclusion of new members from the vote seemed unfair.
items.exampleZh: 把新會員排除在投票之外，似乎不太公平。

items.exampleEn: He dashed out of the house without his keys.
items.exampleZh: 他沒帶鑰匙就衝出了家門。

items.sentenceEn: Wild horses roam freely across the hills.
items.sentenceZh: 野馬在山丘上自由地遊蕩。

items.audioEn: I made a mad dash for the bus, but it left just before I got there.
items.audioZh: 我拚命衝去趕公車，但它就在我到之前開走了。
options: No, the bus was already gone

items.sentenceEn: The kids exclaimed with joy when they opened the box.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們打開盒子時開心地歡呼。

items.sentenceEn: My little brother gave my hair a hard tug.
items.sentenceZh: 我弟弟用力扯了一下我的頭髮。

items.stemEn: "I passed!" my sister ____ as she read the letter.
items.stemZh: 「我考過了！」我的姊妹一邊讀信一邊驚呼。

items.stemEn: All meals are included, and drinks are the only ____ from the price.
items.stemZh: 所有餐點都包含在內，只有飲料不含在價格裡。

items.passageEn: Last spring, my friends and I visited an abandoned mining village in the mountains. Nobody has lived there for forty years, and now wild goats roam the empty streets. We saw an old wagon lying overturned by the road and piles of rubble where houses once stood. Suddenly, it started to rain heavily, and we made a dash for the old school. While we waited, our guide explained that the mine closed because of the discharge of dirty water into the river.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，我和朋友們去參觀山裡一座廢棄的礦村。那裡四十年來都沒人住了，現在只有野山羊在空蕩蕩的街上遊蕩。我們看到一輛舊推車翻倒在路邊，以前蓋著房子的地方只剩一堆堆瓦礫。突然下起大雨，我們趕緊衝進那間舊學校。等雨停時，導遊解釋說，礦場是因為把髒水排進河裡而關閉的。

questions.questionZh: 下大雨時，他們做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 法院推翻了原本的判決。
referenceEn: The court overturned the original decision.
The original decision was overturned by the court.
rubricZh: 要用 overturn（例如 overturned the decision）
句型例如主動句、被動句等都可以

items.promptZh: 放學後，那些青少年常常在購物中心裡閒逛。
referenceEn: After school, the teenagers often roam around the shopping center.
The teenagers often roam the shopping center after school.
rubricZh: roam 當動詞，可接 around 或直接接地點（例如 roam around the shopping center、roam the mall 等）
often 可放動詞前或句尾，位置不扣分
「購物中心」可寫，例如 shopping center、mall 等
